'''Tallis Outpost''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was [[Battle at Tallis Outpost|assaulted]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
